tei:div.tei:p: 239)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: ḍā ki'i tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i sprin dpung bzhugs: na mo gu ru padma kā ra ye:

gsang sngags lam zhugs rnal 'byor pho mo rnams: yang gsang thugs sgrub zab mo la brten nas: nyams chags bskang zhing bsod nams tshogs rjogs phyir: rjes rim rnal 'byor tshogs kyi rim pa bstan: sa ma ya: sbyor ba bza' bca' btung ba la sogs dang: dkar gsum mngar gsum zas sna shing tog rigs: spod kyi rigs byed la sogs 'byor tshogs kun: sel med gtsang zhing yid 'ong 'du byas te: phud nyams kha tshar la sogs skyon spangs nas: dbus 'bur mtha' mnyam ri rab tshul du bkod: khyad par brtul zhugs rdzas gnyis med mi rung: rdzas rnams thabs g.yas shes rab g.yon du bshams: 'byor tshogs 'dod yon rol mtsho'i tshul du ni: mdun rgyab rnams su ma 'chol legs bshams nas: bzang shing spos kyis bdug cing mi gtsang sbyangs: sa ma ya: de nas tshogs rdzas bdud rtsir byin brlab ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang nyid ye shes lha yi thugs ka nas: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis: tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin nyes skyon 'bag btsog kun: rdo rje'i mes bsregs ye shes rlung gis gtor: chu yis gzung 'dzin dri ma dbyings su sbyangs: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: slar yang 240)snying po 'bru gsum 'phros pa las: rang byung bde chen bhandha'i snod mchog tu: oṃ gyis dbyings nas 'dod yon tshogs su spel: āḥyis sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ru bsgyur: hūm̐ gis bde stong zag med ye shes bskyed: sku gsum mkha' 'gro mnyes tshim dgyes pa'i rdzas: kun bzang nam mkha' mdzod du byin gyis brlabs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum brjod la: nam mkha' mdzod sngags mchod pa'i sprin gzungs brjod: de nas tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min bde ba chen po'i zhing: lhun grub bkod pa rab rdzogs dbus: bde chen 'gyur med gzhal yas su: chos sku'i zhing na kun bzang mo: longs sku rnal 'byor wa ra hi: sprul sku ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: rje mo mtsho rgyal zhes su grags:

'khor du rig 'dzin lha tshogs dang: rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir: 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus kun: tshogs kyi 'du bar gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor cog ldebs se ldem: lhag ma zar bu ta la la: rgyan cha mang po si li li: rig 'dzin gar 'chams shigs se shig: dpa' bo dpa' mo sprin ltar gtibs: ging chen glu bro khrigs se khrig: 241)brgyud 'dzin byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mdzes khri pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: dgyes dgongs mchog gi dngos grub stsol: badzra dzñā na ḍā ki ni sā ra dza ya baṃ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya dzaḥbadzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ tiṣṭha badzra: de nas bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos dbyings mtha' bral dbu ma'i dbyings: snang stong ro rkyang zung 'jug lam: sku gsum mnyam sbyor zad med bcud: bde stong bdud rtsi bla med rdzas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes phyir 'bul: bzhes la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: ma hā sarba dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hiḥ de nas tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: oṃ: bde skyong bhandha'i snod yangs par: snang srid bcud bsdus 'dod yon dpal: ye shes bdud rtsi bla na med: zag med ye shes bskyed pa'i rdzas: longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: gus pas 'bul lo bzhes nas kyang: dgyes skong dngos grub ma lus stsol: badzra dzñā na ḍā ki ni sā ra dza ya bam̐ ha ri ni sa hrīḥdza sarba ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hiḥ de nas bshags pa ni: hoḥ ye shes 242)mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs gsan cing dgongs: bdag cag ma rig gnyis snang 'khrul dbang gis: gsang sngags zab mo'i gzhung dang 'gal ba gang: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di yis bshags: mi bsgrib tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra satwa sa ma ya sogs: āḥ de nas bsgral ba ni:

hūm̐ hrīḥ bdag rtog ma rig 'khrul pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdag med mnyam nyid yangs pa'i hom du khug: ye shes rol pa'i thun mtshon drag pos bsgral: gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i 'khor lo dbyings su bshig: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta sogs: gnod byed dgra bgegs sarba shā truṃ mā ra ya sbad sod rbad nan: de nas bstab pa ni: hūm̐: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag phung khams kun: rtsa gsum dam can dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i zhal du bstab: ka dag 'khrul mi shes pa'i sa ru sgrol: sarba shā truṃ ru tra mā ra ya khā hiḥ de nas dngos grub la rol ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lus gdan gsum rnam dag dkyil 'khor du: kha ya rkan thabs mchog dpa' bo dang: lce shes rab gsang ba yum chen mo: de 243)mnyam sbyor zag med bde ba'i bcud: gnas sgo gsum bum pa'i snod du bskyil: dbang dngos grub ma lus kun thob rdzas: de tshim pa drug ldan ngang du rol: a la la hoḥ de nas lhag ma ni: hūm̐ bhyo: dpal chen bka' nyan lhag sdud ma: mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis dang: 'bar ma la sogs lhag mgron rnams: 'dir gshegs 'dod yon tshogs lhag rol: phyi nang bar chad rkyen ngan bzlog: phrin las gang bcol yongs grub mdzod: sa ma ya u tstshiṣṭa bā liṃ ta khā hiḥ de nas bskul pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: ma g.yel thugs dam gnad nas bskul: chos kyi dbyings las skur bzhaings la: gsang sngags bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyongs: rnal 'byor nyams rtogs yon tan spel: mtha' mi dbus su ma btang bar: rgyal bstan dar rgyas yun brtan mdzod: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: ma 'da' ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: sgrub pa'i 'bras bu dus 'dir stsol: de nas chad don btang ba ni: hūm̐ bhyo: gzhi dbyings 'gyur med ka dag dus kyi tshe: gzhi snang lhun grub don gyi 'og min nas: rnam kun 244)mchog ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas:

rang gsal sgyu 'phrul 'khor la brda ston tshe: rtsal snang rol pa'i dregs pa pho mo yis: rang rtsal 'khor la bka' nan bstan srung bar: khas blangs dam bcas tha tshig gnyer gtad pa'i: gsang sngags bka' yi srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs: 'dir gshegs chad don gtor ma 'di longs la: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe bsring ba dang: mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs bzlog par ma chad dam: 'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun rkyen legs tshogs sgrubs: rab 'byams phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon gyi tha tshig g.yar dam ma 'dor bar: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: dus las ma 'da' badzra sa ma ya: de nas brtan ma sbyong ba ni: ma bhyo: sngon tshe rgyal dbang padma thod phreng gis: spyan sngar brtan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa'i: bod skyong bstan ma ya ma skyong ma'i tshogs: 'khor dang yang 'khor bcas pa ma lus kun: 'dir gshegs bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon gyi tha tshig gnyen po ma g.yel bar: gsang sngags 245)bstan dang bstan 'dzin sde skyongs la: mi mthun dus kyi rgud pa mtha' dag sol: mtha' mi ha ra'i gnod pa rdul du rlog: sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas srungs phrin las mdzod: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa'i: rab 'byams las kun ma lus 'grub par mdzod: bhyo ma ma bhyo dzaḥbha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ de nas bro mnan ni: hūm̐: gsang chen rol pa mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: dngos grub sgrub la bar gcod dam sri bgegs: rnam thar gsum ldan gru gsum mkha' ru brubs: 'chor med ye shes rol pa'i phyag rgyas mnan: nam yang ldang med sku gsum bro rgyas gdab: oṃ laṃ: āḥlaṃ: hūm̐ laṃ: st+waṃ bha ya nan: mā ra ya nan: de nas dngos grub blang ba ni: hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor gyi: gsang gsum rdo rje'i klong mdzod nas:

byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub kun: 'bru gsum 'od kyi rnam pa ru: bdag gi gnas gsum thim pa yis: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang dngos grub: ma lus yongs su rdzogs thob nas: dga' bzhi'i ye shes mngon gyur cing: mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba che'i: dngos grub dam pa 246)deng 'dir stsol: rtsa sngags ma thar: oṃ kā ya siddhi oṃ: āḥwakka siddhi āḥ hūm̐ tsitta siddhi hūm̐: hrīḥsarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ de nas lhag chad bskang ba ni: hoḥ mkha' 'gro ma yi dkyil 'khor du: bdag gi sgo gsum 'khrul dbang gis: bskyed rim ting 'dzin g.yel ba dang: sngags bzlas ma dag 'khyal tshig 'dres: cho ga gzhung bzhin ma ldan pas: 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bzod par gsol: ma sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ sa ma ya: āḥs ma ya: hūm̐ sa ma yaḥ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya sogs: āḥ lan gsum brjod: de nas bsngo ba ni: hoḥ bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa yi: rnam dkar dge tshogs ci mchis kun: ma gyur 'gro ba sems can rnams: rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo: lan gsum brjod mthar smon lam ni: hūm̐: snang srid dag mnyam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: ma bcos yongs grub chen po'i mos gus kyis: skye zhing skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du: ḍā ki'i rje mo lhag pa'i lhar bzung nas: rim gnyis zab mo'i lam dang mi 'bral zhing: sa lam yon tan rtogs pa mngon gyur nas: mkha' spyod dhu ma 247)tha la'i gnas mchog tu: rnam kun mchog ldan don gyi rnal 'byor ma: rje mo mtsho rgyal nyid dang dbyer med par: zag med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob shog: de nas bsdu ldang ni: hūm̐: snang cha thabs kyis bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: stong nyid spros pa bral ba'i dbyings su āḥ slar yang chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhin: rjes thob ye shes sgyu ma'i lha skur bzhengs: rtsa sngags mthar: badzra rakṣa rakṣa bhrum̐: de nas bkra shis ni:

āḥ skye med spros pa bral ba'i dbyings: chos sku'i mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog: lhun grub 'gags med yon tan rdzogs: longs sku'i mkha' 'gro'i= mkhyen gnyis shes rab ye shes dpal: sprul sku'i mkha' 'gro'i= gzhi grol nyon mongs dgra rgyal ba: sku gsum lhun grub bkra shis gang: deng 'dir sgrub mchog rnams la stsol: gzhon nu bum sku'i bkra shis shog: ces dang gzhan yang bkra shis ci rigs kyi mtha' brgyan par bya'o: sa ma ya: de ltar ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: brten nas dam bskang mchog 'grub thabs: bsod nams nang nas tshogs 'khor mchog: ḍā ki 'du ba'i thabs chen po: 'di la rgyun du brtson gyur na: phyi ma rang snang dag pa'i 248) gnas: dpal ri padma 'od gling du: dpa' bo dpa' mos mdun bsus te: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral du: 'khod de dgongs zab gnad thob nas: khams gsum 'khor ba ma stongs bar: don gnyis phrin las 'byung bar nges: the tshom med dngos ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gter rgya: brda thim: : zhes ḍā ki'i tshogs mchod 'di yang skyes bu rig pa'i ral gri'am rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul gter chen padma gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos rdzas du ma dang bcas te bka' gsung nan tan chen po spyi bor phebs pa ldog tu ma nus par kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// dge'o//
